target.title: fix(google): reject malformed provider media base64
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Google provider responses could include malformed inline audio or video base64 that Node would decode permissively instead of rejecting.

## Why This Change Was Made

Google music, speech, video generation, and Realtime Live audio now share a strict base64 decoder before materializing provider-returned media. The Google-specific decoder accepts both standard base64 and Google ProtoJSON-valid base64url payloads before canonical validation, while inline video bytes reuse the existing generated-video byte cap before decode so oversized payloads fail before allocating the full buffer.

## User Impact

Users get a clear provider error for malformed Google media responses without rejecting valid base64url media that Google may return. Realtime Live malformed inline audio is routed through `onError` without emitting corrupt audio, and operators keep the existing video media cap behavior without permissive base64 decoding.

## Evidence

Live Google TTS run through the production `buildGoogleSpeechProvider().synthesize()` entrypoint; this was captured on the earlier PR head `f36b9f96544a6416e51712ee3881e682409df825` before the base64url compatibility follow-up, and the same entrypoint remains covered by focused regression tests on current head `4f77e023235`:

```text
$ GEMINI_API_KEY=<redacted> node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-providers.config.ts extensions/google/live-google-tts-proof.test.ts --reporter verbose

=== LIVE GOOGLE TTS PROOF ===
entrypoint=buildGoogleSpeechProvider().synthesize
started_at=2026-07-14T12:47:34.918Z
model=gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview
voice=Kore
proxy=explicit-redacted
api_key=redacted
ok=true
output_format=wav
file_extension=.wav
audio_bytes=109484
pcm_payload_bytes=109440
wav_header=RIFF/WAVE
```

The focused tests drive the real exported provider entrypoints — `buildGoogleSpeechProvider().synthesize()`, `buildGoogleMusicGenerationProvider().generateMusic()`, `buildGoogleVideoGenerationProvider().generateVideo()`, and `buildGoogleRealtimeVoiceProvider().createBridge()` — with crafted valid, malformed, and oversized provider responses; the `decodeGoogleProviderBase64` guard runs as real production code on those response paths:

- **Valid path preserved:** legitimate standard base64 and base64url audio/video still materialize; the video byte cap reuses the existing generated-video limit rather than a new arbitrary value, so valid traffic is not truncated.
- **Malformed rejected:** music, speech, video, and Google Live malformed inline base64 each raise a provider-specific error instead of decoding corrupt bytes; the Live path does not call `onAudio`.
- **Oversized rejected before buffering:** inline video bytes, direct URI downloads, and SDK file-handle downloads exceeding the media cap fail before unbounded allocation.

Real-trigger-chain run of the production `buildGoogleSpeechProvider().synthesize()` entrypoint with a crafted TTS response:

```text
=== GOOGLE SPEECH (real buildGoogleSpeechProvider().synthesize) ===
[valid PCM 2048B] synthesize ok=true  decoded audio bytes=2092
[malformed] rejected: Google TTS response returned malformed audio base64
[base64url] synthesize ok=true  decoded pcm payload bytes=4
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/realtime-voice-provider.test.ts extensions/google/music-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/google/speech-provider.test.ts extensions/google/video-generation-provider.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-providers.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.9 /home/0668000974/Projects/Openclaw/auto-pr/workspace/openclaw/worktrees/pr-106969

 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  98 passed (98)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard
```

CI notes:

- Rebased onto latest `origin/main`. The earlier `check-dependencies` failure flagged an unused export (`CurrentUserTimestampOverride`) in `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-session-boundary.ts`, a file this PR never touches; it was a stale-base artifact and clears after the rebase.
- Fixed the `check-lint` `oxlint(curly)` error by adding braces to the guard in `extensions/google/speech-provider.ts`.

<details>
<summary>Focused reproduction commands</summary>

```bash
PNPM_CONFIG_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE=0 PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false \
```

target.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue
target.body:
# PR5/5 - internal session delivery handoff + final hardening

## What Problem This Solves

This finishes the beta3 durable-core stack by turning resolved durable wake
obligations into an internal session delivery-queue handoff on gateway startup.
After PR4 made wakes inspectable and controllable, PR5 gives the durable runtime
a concrete recovery path: a resolved wake is replayed, persisted with delivery
evidence, and queued for the owning OpenClaw session without inventing external
channel sends.

## Stack position

- Stack item: PR5/5
- Clean PR5 comparison: `a30e2b6ce4e5f1390599380aedc82078c98854f7..443ffd2292e146fad3c089a03382a5f4702632f7`
- PR4 dependency: `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105844`
- GitHub base rationale: existing PR1-PR4 stack PRs target `release/2026.7.1`; the PR4 branch exists on the fork, not as an upstream base branch, so this PR follows stack convention while documenting the exact PR4-head diff.

## Scope

- Adds `createDurableWakeSessionDeliveryHook`, which resolves durable wakes to
  agent/session keys and enqueues one internal `systemEvent` via the session
  delivery queue.
- Wires gateway startup durable wake replay through that hook.
- Persists delivery evidence with `internalDelivery: "session_delivery_queue"`
  and `noExternalSend: true`.
- Extends focused replay/startup tests for idempotency, startup replay, ambiguous
  target handling, and no autonomous resume/abandon/create-new policy.
- Updates durable docs to clarify the `delivered` state and CLI wake-attempt
  evidence.

## Non-scope

- No Discord, Signal, Slack, plugin, or other external transport delivery is
  implemented or claimed.
- No cron mutation.
- No release/changelog/package churn from the stale old PR5 ancestry.
- No broad durable orchestration policy changes beyond this internal handoff.

## Evidence

Clean scope:

```text
6 files changed, 372 insertions(+), 50 deletions(-)
```

Focused behavior:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/durable/wake-delivery-replay.test.ts src/durable/startup.test.ts
# pass: 2 files, 14 tests
```

Adjacent durable CLI/Gateway/read-path proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/durable.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts src/durable/wake-controls-inspection.test.ts
# pass: 3 Vitest shards, 4 files, 25 tests
```

Static/docs gates:

```bash
pnpm check:test-types
# pass

pnpm check:docs
# pass

git diff --check a30e2b6ce4e5f1390599380aedc82078c98854f7..HEAD
# pass
```

Remote proof attempts were made but unavailable in this shell:

```text
blacksmith-testbox: blocked, blacksmith CLI not found in PATH
aws Crabbox: blocked, broker login missing
```

## Upgrade contract

This PR adds no schema migration. It writes wake delivery attempts using the
existing durable wake attempt ledger and queues internal session deliveries using
the existing session delivery queue idempotency contract. Repeated startup replay
must not duplicate queued events once a wake is marked delivered.

## Risk / limits

- Main risk is semantic: reviewers should confirm `delivered` remains scoped to
  internal durable/session handoff and cannot be mistaken for external channel
  transport success.
- Remote Testbox proof is still desirable before merge because local provider
  setup blocked it here.
- Full release validation was not run for this narrow PR5 slice.

@clawsweeper review



### Live Gateway startup/restart proof at PR5 head

Additional live Gateway startup/restart proof at PR5 head `443ffd2292e146fad3c089a03382a5f4702632f7` was collected using a real local Gateway process twice against the same isolated state dir.

This proof intentionally disables external channels/plugins and does not claim Discord, Slack, Telegram, plugin, or other external transport delivery, end-user-visible consumption, live attached-session consumption, topology cleanup, or merge readiness. In PR5, `delivered` means internal durable/session-queue handoff only: ownership transferred to the persisted session delivery queue.

Result summary:

```text
startup 1:
- real Gateway process started and recorded durable gateway startup
- one resolved wake moved pending -> delivered
- exactly-once internal session delivery queue handoff
- wake delivery attempt count: 1
- evidence.kind: wake_internal_session_delivery_enqueued

- evidence.sessionKey: agent:main:main
- pending session delivery count: 1
- pending queue entry kind: systemEvent

startup 2 against the same isolated state dir:
- real Gateway process started again and recorded durable gateway startup
- wake delivery attempt count remained 1
- pending session delivery count remained 1
- queue id remained dfb326421eea3baa89c510ea5642d11110fc439000a979c32fe1c1b5a9fbba59
- no duplicate wake attempt or queue entry was created

- failed: 0

- pending session delivery count: 0
- final wake count: 1

```

The live Gateway startup command used for both starts:

```bash
env OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="$STATE_DIR" \
  OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH="$CONFIG_PATH" \
  OPENCLAW_DURABLE_RUNTIME=1 \
  OPENCLAW_DURABLE_WORKER=0 \
  OPENCLAW_SKIP_CHANNELS=1 \
  OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 \
  OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_STARTUP_TRACE=1 \
  OPENCLAW_ACPX_RUNTIME_STARTUP_PROBE=0 \
  OPENCLAW_DISABLE_PLUGIN_REGISTRY_MIGRATION=1 \
  node --import tsx src/entry.ts gateway \
    --port "$PORT" --bind loopback --auth none --tailscale off \
    --allow-unconfigured --ws-log compact --verbose
```

Representative startup logs:


```text

```

Reset-boundary proof remains scoped to the existing focused test: queued `agentTurn` entries carry `expectedSessionId` and are skipped across a session-generation mismatch, while PR5 durable wake handoff queues a `systemEvent` against the canonical current session key. This surfaces the durable wake internally without autonomous resume or new-session policy.

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server-restart-sentinel.test.ts -t "does not dispatch a queued agentTurn continuation after the session key changes|still delivers systemEvent continuations for completed run entries" --reporter verbose
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  2 passed | 26 skipped (28)
```

The stack topology / CI drift item is unchanged by this proof. The clean PR5 slice does not modify `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, but the public cumulative PR diff still includes workflow drift because the branch is stacked on earlier durable work. That remains a sequencing/rebase issue before merge.
